detail.longDescription: Raymond Camden: My To Do – Replacing what Microsoft is Killing. “Earlier this week I shared the bad news that Microsoft is killing off To Do, one of the best, simplest apps around. I built a simple export tool to let you get your existing To Dos in either JSON or HTML format. At the time, I hinted at a plan to replace the app, and today I’m happy to share it.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/11/26/raymond-camden-my-to-do-replacing-what-microsoft-is-killing/
